text:
Aisha: FYI alert 11:01 UTC: spike of TLS handshake rejects in eu-west-1 and ap-south-1. looks like rotator unwrap failures after last night's RBAC prune.
Tom: can you paste the error sample?
Aisha: log snippet:
```
2026-03-21T11:01:08Z proxy: TLS handshake failed: peer rejected key-id 'ephemeral-rc-12f' reason=unknown-key-id region=eu-west-1
```
Raj: which RBAC change? i removed an old keystore role to tighten perms.
Aisha: PR notes show removal of "keystore-operator-legacy" and added a region condition to "keystore-reader" limiting unwraps to us-east-1.
rotator-bot: rotator log:
```
2026-03-21T10:57:50Z ERROR unwrap key=ephemeral-rc-12f err=KMS::AccessDenied principal=svc-rotator region=eu-west-1
```
Emily: likely cause: rotator can't decrypt cross-region keys, proxies keep stale key-ids and peers refuse them.
Tom: mitigation: rollback RBAC change (fast) + add targeted kms:Decrypt for rotator on ephemeral keys.
Aisha: rolling back now.
oncall-bot: Incident SEC-2026-03-21-009 created. Owners: Aisha, Tom.
Aisha: rollback applied 11:10 UTC. rotator progress:
```
2026-03-21T11:11:22Z INFO unwrap succeeded key=ephemeral-rc-12f
2026-03-21T11:11:40Z INFO rotation complete for service-c
```
Tom: restarted proxies in eu-west-1 and ap-south-1 to clear caches.
Emily: post-incident actions:
- alert for repeated KMS::AccessDenied by rotator (>3 in 5m) correlated with proxy handshake fails
- add integration test simulating RBAC prune vs rotator
- ensure rotator logs key-id+principal+region in structured audit logs
Raj: i'll open PR to keep region conditions but explicitly allow svc-rotator and rotator-managed principals.
Aisha: marking mitigated 11:18 UTC. adding postmortem to security docs. thanks all. :thumbsup:
